title: billing.release
description: Payload for the billing.release comm Function — hand a hold's credits back (wrapper over stapel_billing.services.release). Each portion returns to a lot carrying the expiry of the lot it was taken from, so a released subscription bundle does not become non-expiring. No idempotency_key: hold_id IS the key — releasing a hold that is already captured, released or expired is a no-op, so a retried release cannot conjure credits. Returns {"ok": bool, "balance": int|null, "status": str|null, "reason": str|null}; reason is hold_not_found.
